workflow: The production cad-core publish planner and cad-print PDF writer generate reordered multi-page, excluded, separate and inactive-Display outputs twice from the shared F-105 fixture. pypdf, pdfplumber and Poppler inspect every output; PDF operators independently expose the Display source clip and transform, while order and geometry mutations are applied independently.
result: Production output matched the Chromium download bytes exactly, including the inactive SECTION 10 Display PDF and its exact stored source window. Output was deterministic, preserved non-alphabetic PLAN 20 then SECTION 10 order, exclusion and Windows-safe length-bounded collision names, and contained no image XObjects. Reversing page order or changing geometry changed the PDF hash.
